_note: Business identity for customer-facing deliverables. Ships with placeholder values - replace them with your own business identity before sending anyone anything. This file is NOT for secrets (no EIN, no bank details, no passwords).
report_disclaimer: Screening-level report from public data. Not a substitute for an engineered site plan, wetlands delineation, soil/perc testing, or laboratory testing of the finished well. Verify all rules, fees, and parcel details against current authoritative documents before acting.
tagline: Know your water before you buy the land.
